temp_delta_c.label: Warmer growing seasons
temp_delta_c.plain: Shifts every month's temperatures. Changes planting dates, heat days, frost days and how thirsty the air is.

rain_pct.label: More or less rain
rain_pct.plain: Scales yearly rain and snow. Same number of storms, each one bigger or smaller.

storm_intensity_pct.label: Rain arriving in heavier bursts
storm_intensity_pct.plain: The same total rain falls in fewer, heavier storms. More runs off, less soaks in, and bare soil erodes faster.

water_cap_pct.label: Irrigation water you can pump
water_cap_pct.plain: Cuts the irrigation allocation. 100% is today's allocation; 0% is no irrigation at all.

presets.label: Hot, dry decade
presets.description: A run of years like 2012 or 2022: 2 C warmer, a fifth less rain.

presets.label: Allocation cut by 40%
presets.description: A groundwater plan or a dry-year curtailment trims pumping.

presets.label: Fewer, heavier storms
presets.description: Same rain in bigger bursts, as the heaviest-day trend suggests.

presets.label: Mid-century outlook
presets.description: A plausible 2050s combination: warmer, slightly drier, stormier, less water to pump.

note: Scenarios shift the observed 2001-2024 record. They are stress tests, not forecasts.
